items.title: Drake Sued Over ‘Janice STFU’ by Producer Who Says Rapper Stole His Chorus
items.summary: Drake is being sued for copyright infringement on his hit “Janice STFU” by a producer who says the rapper and his team “shamelessly refuse to acknowledge” his substantial contributions. Drake has been hit with a copyright infringement lawsuit over his hit song “Janice STFU” by a producer named Aviel Calev Hirschfield,…

items.title: Elephant In the Room Reminder: Major Hits from Kylie Minogue and Nick Cave Already Used to Train AI Without Compensation, the ICMP Tells Australian Legislators
items.summary: The global trade body ICMP warns that AI training may lead to the dilution of Australian copyright laws, effectively “legitimizing larceny.” The International Confederation of Music Publishers (ICMP) has cautioned the Australian government against giving in to efforts from tech companies seeking to weaken copyright law…

items.title: Sony and Universal Demand DistroKid AI Music Upload Data in Copyright Battle
Universal Music and Sony Music Tighten the Screws on Suno Investor Lightspeed, Demanding Docs About the Platform’s Training Data, ‘Impact on the Music Industry,’ and More
items.summary: On top of aggressively pushing to learn DistroKid’s AI release volume, Universal Music and Sony Music are now demanding that Suno investor Lightspeed testify and provide a trove of documents concerning the platform’s training and more. That subpoena sub-dispute quietly boiled over one month ago, when Lightspeed Venture…

items.title: ‘The only way to properly create value in music is to make lasting copyrights.’
items.summary: Newly confirmed as sole Chairman and CEO of Warner Records Group, Aaron Bay-Schuck tells MBW why patience beats volume, why WMG needs two frontline label groups, and why the AI flood only makes a very human record company worth more... Source

items.title: Majors and BMG lose Supreme Court fight over songwriters’ worldwide copyright reclaims – on a technicality
items.summary: Their challenge ended on Monday (October 19) without the court ruling on its merits, after four of its nine justices sat the case out Source

items.title: La legislación sobre derechos de autor tiene dificultades para adaptarse a la música creada con inteligencia artificial en Corea del Sur.
RIAA Flags Anna’s Archive and AI Voice Cloner to U.S. Government
items.summary: The RIAA has submitted its latest overview of "notorious markets" to the U.S. Government. It lists familiar names such as The Pirate Bay and Rapidgator, but the music group also flags shadow library Anna's Archive and AI voice-cloning service Lalals. The RIAA presents both as "additional" areas of concern, not as offic…

items.title: Publishing body ICMP blasts potential AI rules in Australia
items.summary: Australia’s government is currently devising its future policies on AI, training and copyright. We recently reported on labels body ARIA’s boss Annabelle Herd’s testimony at a select-committee hearing as part of that process. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Musixmatch acquires Songdex and Blokur owner Music Reports
items.summary: Lyrics firm Musixmatch was founded 16 years ago, but has never bought another company… until now. It has announced the acquisition of Music Reports, the US firm that owns the Songdex copyright registry as well as rights and licensing firm Blokur. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Universal Music appoints first AI director amid copyright lawsuits
Deezer permitirá ocultar la música hecha con IA al buscar
items.summary: Deezer permitirá a sus usuarios ocultar la música generada íntegramente con inteligencia artificial. La plataforma francesa ha anunciado un interruptor que, una vez activado, excluirá de los resultados de búsqueda las canciones, los álbumes y los artistas vinculados a contenido 100% sintético. La función llegará a todo…

tip.title: Guarda evidencia de la fecha de creación
tip.body: Un correo a ti mismo con el archivo adjunto, un repositorio con historial o un servicio de sellado de tiempo cuestan poco y construyen una línea de tiempo defendible.

tip.title: Keep evidence of your creation date
tip.body: An email to yourself with the file attached, a repository with history, or a timestamping service cost little and build a defensible timeline.
